feat(wire): request quality CCB035 (Ra 0.35) for one 20 mm punch on the zero-step setup

Port the Ra 0.35 selection of #2966 onto the zero-step setup of #2984.
The condition AGIE_BERCO_RA035 makes the piece create the one quality
object CCB035 (Ra 0.35, Te 1.50, Tkm 1.00) instead of CCB030. The job
arms no technology; the operator assigns TECCUT after the review.

- agie_setup::Quality on the private Piece; PunchSetup20::encode_quality
  is the only way to request CCB035. Die, group and cutoff keep CCB030.
- CCB035_OFFSETS_UM: 20 mm only, 245/155/140/134 um, from the PR and the
  emulated control. The contour checks use the offsets of the quality.
- agie::export_punch_with_review; with CCB030 it writes the bytes of
  export_with_review.
- The app refuses AGIE_BERCO_RA035 for a group and a DXF arc punch; the
  post refuses other heights, a die and an open cut. No files.
- FINE20 golden, checked on the emulated Classic Cut 2S.

Fixes #2966

feat(post): CCB035 requests the Ra 0.35 technology with the speed flag

The control check of 25 Nov showed that the CCB035 request with three
disabled options preselects the Ra 0.30 technology. With the first
option (speed, "Snelheid") set, the TECCUT header is TYPE:VS and the
control preselects estbca25nsn060b035020 by itself. The job still arms
no technology (CCB035[0] after import).

- The quality line becomes "0.35,1.50,1.00,T,F,F". CCB030 is unchanged.
- CCB035_OFFSETS_UM holds the five measured passes: 234, 189, 154, 139
  and 129 um. Quality::offsets_um returns all passes; rough_um gives the
  main cut for the clearance, miter and entry checks. The 0.4 mm stock
  margin stays (0.234 + 0.125 rounds up to 0.4).
- The review text names the technology, the TYPE:VS header, 5 passes
  and the five offsets, and tells the operator to stop if they differ.
- The user guide and docs/decisions/2966-agie-fine-quality.md record
  the measurement. Only the quality line of the FINE20 SBL golden moves.
- The agie_quality tests move unchanged into the agie_native suite as
  the module quality (28 tests: 25 + 3).

Fixes #2966
